administrators.label: Administrators
administrators.description: Individuals responsible for configuring, managing, and maintaining a system or application.

api-developers.label: API Developers
api-developers.description: Developers who build integrations with APIs, including understanding authentication, endpoints, and data formats.

documentation-engineers.label: Documentation Engineers
documentation-engineers.description: Engineers who apply software engineering practices to documentation, including automation, CI/CD, and tooling.

end-users.label: End Users
end-users.description: Individuals who use a software application or system to perform tasks, but do not administer or develop it.

engineering-teams.label: Engineering Teams
engineering-teams.description: Software engineers who contribute to or consume documentation as part of their work.

merchant-developers.label: Merchant Developers
merchant-developers.description: Developers who integrate payment or commerce solutions into merchant websites or applications.

product-managers.label: Product Managers
product-managers.description: Individuals responsible for defining product direction and requirements.

stakeholders.label: Stakeholders
stakeholders.description: Individuals with an interest in a project, such as managers, clients, or reviewers.

subject-matter-experts.label: Subject Matter Experts
subject-matter-experts.description: Individuals with deep knowledge of a specific domain who provide input to documentation.

technical-writers.label: Technical Writers
technical-writers.description: Professionals who create and maintain technical documentation.
